proposed.text: In episode 55, Elena, an Inhuman whose bursts of speed snap her back to where she started, helps Daisy's team storm a corrupt police station in Bogotá, then stays behind in Colombia.

verdicts.why: The fault is real (in 'Bouncing Back' she helps raid the Colombian police station but stays in Colombia, first joining a Secret Warriors mission in 'The Team'), but sources differ on who proposes she stay (Joey's offer she declines on her page, Daisy's suggestion on the episode page), so the text leaves that detail out.

proposed.text: In season 1, the team takes a Tesseract-powered HYDRA weapon from Peru, and S.H.I.E.L.D. sends it to the Slingshot to be launched into the sun.

verdicts.why: On screen in 'The 0-8-4' the weapon is taken to the Slingshot and launched toward the sun; that it was really kept in the Fridge is a reveal in the raid episodes later in the season, which the next record already covers.

proposed.text: Layla tracks down her husband Marc and helps him and Steven hunt for Ammit's tomb in Egypt. She becomes Taweret's avatar to fight Harrow's forces in Cairo.
